long_biography.plain_text:
AFB Bank sits at the centre of Hikmat Abuzar oglu Ismayilov's business portfolio. In 2019, he bought Gilan Holding's near-total interest and became the bank's ultimate controlling shareholder. The institution operates under an Azerbaijani banking licence and serves individual and business customers. Ismayilov remains its dominant owner, with only small minority holdings outside his control.

His financial interests extend beyond that position. Ismayilov has long held 31.11 percent of Bank of Baku, alongside NAB Holding and Azpetrol Oil Company. He is also the sole shareholder of AzSigorta, an Azerbaijani non-life insurer. The combination gives him exposure to two distinct banking franchises and insurance, with AFB representing control and Bank of Baku a substantial minority investment. Across these businesses, his consistent public role is that of shareholder rather than a named day-to-day executive.
